text: Ironvale Athletic’s Jonah Lindgren swings in a cross from the right corner at the far end. Jonah Lindqvist moves in from the close left side, about 10 metres from goal, and fires a shot with his foot. Redmond Rovers’ goalkeeper Sami Osei reacts quickly, diving low to his left to make a fine save and keep the score at 0-1.
